id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

model.description: {@link MlModel} associated with this series of monitoring results.

metricName.description: the name of the {@link MlScoringMetric} that produced this series of results.

filter.description:
String representation of the {@link Filter} that corresponds to the {@link MlModel.Monitor.Group#groupBy} and
{@link MlModel.Monitor.Batch#groupByValue}, as well as the {@link MlModel.Monitor.Group#filter}, used to compute
the values associated with this header.
The filter typically represents the sub-segment of data and/or subjects that the metric was computed for.
This field is expected to be set automatically and *consistently* by {@link MlModel.Monitor.Job}.

e.g. groupBy = ["country", "city"] and groupByValue = ["USA", "NYC"] would produce filter string 'country=="USA" && city=="NYC"'
e.g. if there was an additional monitor group filter "assetType == 'windTurbine'", the filter string would be
     "(country=='USA' && city=='NYC') && (assetType == 'windTurbine')"

metricBaseline.description:
Optional baseline to associate to this {@link #model} and {@link #metricName}, in the context of the provided {@link #filter}.
Note: this can be used in conjunction with {@link #metricHigherIsBetter} to get some sense of how good a {@link MlModel.Monitor.TimedResult#metricValue} is.

metricHigherIsBetter.description:
Indicates whether a higher {@link MlModel.Monitor.TimedResult#metricValue} is better or worse, for example
relative to the {@link #metricBaseline}.

title:
Header for a series of monitoring results, which are computed for a given {@link MlModel}, {@link MlScoringMetric}, and
data filter.
See related type {@link MlModel.Monitor.TimedResult}.
name: MlModel.Monitor.TimedResultHeader
